items.title: Teamwork and Communication in Startups (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Teamwork and Communication in Startups (PDF 134, printed 130).

blocks.text: Startups aur chhote digital karobar ki kamyabi ke liye teamwork aur communication zaroori hain. Team members mushtarka goals hasil karne ke liye khayalat, zimmedariyan aur skills share kar ke mil kar kaam karte hain. Mo-assar communication ghalat-fehmiyon se bachati hai aur faisle behtar banati hai. Startups mein meetings, messaging apps aur online tools ke zariye wazeh coordination (rabta) kaam ko aasani se chalata hai. Mazboot teamwork aur communication productivity barhate hain aur business ko kamyabi se barhne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Startup mein coordination kin teen cheezon se hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Meetings, messaging apps aur online tools; is se kaam (workflow) aasani se chalta hai.

items: Startup: ideas, zimmedariyan aur skills share; wazeh communication.
Mazboot teamwork se productivity aur karobar ki tarakki.
